MARS HARNESS LAB - VERSION 5

Start with the PowerPoint or presentation PDF. Use the three-harness setup instructions to install the Science, Engineering, and Project Management harnesses from the downloadable skills and agents. Use the architecture guide for implementation, the transcript for delivery, the MOXIE package for the worked example, the recursive specialized-agent operating model for Science, Engineering, and Project Management execution, and the portable-skills guide for runtime adaptation. Individual and complete skill ZIPs are included. Verify downloads with SHA256SUMS.txt.
